paragraphs: A modern web application that talks about Josh Sylvia’s knowledge on technology featuring an AI-powered chatbot with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) capabilities, built with Express.js and optimized for deployment. Searching for josh sylvia tech is completed using Elastic Search. Tutorial provided by jobs are youtube videos, github, and a playground environment.
features: Dual-Model Architecture: Groq API (Llama 3.1 8B Instant) + Local Ollama fine-tuned model
Intelligent Routing: Resume queries → Ollama, General queries → Groq, Knowledge base → Elastic Search
Agentic AI System: Tool-calling capabilities with search, skills, experience, and contact tools
RAG System: Context-aware responses using Elastic Search retrieval
Secure API Key Management: Environment-based configuration
